description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken Knight], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Incandescent Sear Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Knight
description.text: Knight abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Incandescent Sear Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Incandescent Sear after using two Knight abilities
